# Surrey Street Partners

> Product and AI consulting practice focused on payments, commerce, and financial infrastructure. Founded by Vevina McAllister, with Principal Amy Hoffman covering open banking and capital markets.

- [Home](https://surreystreet.ai/): Surrey Street Partners overview and practice areas
- [Consulting](https://surreystreet.ai/consulting/): Engagement model, what we work on, who we work with
- [Team](https://surreystreet.ai/team/): Principal bios — Vevina McAllister and Amy Hoffman
- [Insights](https://surreystreet.ai/blog/): Industry analysis on payments, AI product strategy, and fintech
